messages:
Alex: Quick sync — we need to finalize the PRD for throttling + billing semantics before EOD Friday. Customer asks have bubbled up around long chat sessions and bursty embedding jobs causing unexpected charges.
Mira: Uploaded a first-pass doc: https://redwood.internal/drive/prd/throttle-billing-draft (please comment inline). TL;DR: propose per-token metering + optional per-request cap for interactive sessions.
Kevin: Per-token makes sense, but we should clarify rounding behavior and min-charge. Do we bill by token or by token-window?
Sarah: Acceptance criteria idea: 1) billing matches reported usage in Console within 5% for 95th percentile workloads; 2) UI shows per-route estimate; 3) fallback behaviors defined for quota hits (HTTP 429 + billing notice).
Jamal: Edge case: bulk embedding jobs (hundreds of files) — customers expect job-level pricing (flat) not per-token microcharges that vary wildly. Need a bulk-job mode.
Mira: Draft metering semantics snippet: ```json
{
  "meter_unit": "token",
  "rounding": "per-10-tokens",
  "min_charge": 1,
  "bulk_job_mode": {
    "enabled": false,
    "pricing": "flat_per_job"
  }
}
```
Mira: Rationale: 10-token windows reduce billing noise and aligns with many tokenizer behaviors. We can expose rounding config for Dedicated/Private customers.
Alex: UI question — should limits be per-route, per-model, or per-api-key? Product leaning is per-api-key with optional per-route overrides. Thoughts?
Sarah: Per-api-key default + per-route override seems good. For acceptance tests we need: create limit, hit limit, observe 429 + clear messaging + automatic retry guidance.
Kevin: Also need to define server-side fallback: if model variant unavailable due to capacity, do we route to a cheaper model automatically (and bill differently)? That needs clear semantics in PRD (consent for degrading model).
Jamal: Private/Dedicated note: customers often require deterministic billing for contracts. We should add a contract-mode where rounding is disabled and usage is reported precisely (no auto-fallback).
Mira: Proposed launch criteria checklist: "Docs + API spec published", "Console: limit create/view + estimated cost UI", "SDKs: error handling for 429", "Telemetry: token-level breakdown in logs", "E2E: sample workloads under 3 profiles (chat, embeddings, batch)".
Alex: Can we scope a minimal MVP: metering per-token with 10-token rounding + per-api-key limits + basic UI (create/view) + 429 semantics + docs? Everything else (bulk_job_mode, contract-mode, fallback routing billing rules) as follow-ups.
Sarah: MVP acceptance: add automated tests for billing parity against our meter + integration test with UI showing same numbers. Also create audit events for limit changes.
Kevin: Dev question: what's the expected perf impact of token-level metering? We need a small perf spec: meter emitted by runtime with amortized <<1% latency. I'll ask infra to estimate.
Jamal: Customer ask to expose predicted monthly cost for a configured limit on the UI (estimator). We should include that in scope if it’s a low lift.
Mira: Quick API sketch for limits: ```http
POST /v1/limits
{ "api_key": "key_xxx", "limit": {"type": "tokens", "interval": "minute", "value": 60000}, "override_routes": ["/v1/generate"] }
```
Mira: Response includes current usage + estimated cost per-interval.
Alex: Action items: Mira -> update PRD with MVP scope + API sketch (by Wed). Kevin -> perf impact estimate (tomorrow). Sarah -> acceptance test matrix + UI mock for estimator (end of week). Jamal -> customer-impact doc + list of priority customers who need contract-mode.
deploy-bot: Note: staging feature-flag branch created: feat/billing-throttle-mvp (build 3821).
Sarah: One more edge: streaming responses — we meter tokens as they are emitted. Need to ensure partial-stream billing on connection drop is handled (billing for accumulated tokens sent). Add that to edge-case list.
Mira: Will add streaming partial-charge rule: bill for tokens confirmed as sent in the server stream buffer; client-side disconnects will be billed for server-sent tokens.
Alex: OK. If no major objections, I'll mark this as scoped to MVP and schedule a PRD review on Thu 10am. Please add comments to the doc before then. :thumbsup:
Kevin: +1
Sarah: +1
Jamal: +1
Mira: added comments, will push updates shortly.
Alex: Thanks everyone.
